# Motivation

Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve?

# Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Be as specific as possible.

# Alternatives Considered

Have you thought about different approaches? Why choose this one?

# Impact

- [ ] API addition (new public methods/classes)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Compatibility with external libraries
- [ ] Other (please specify)

# Additional Context

Include any references (papers, repos, packages) that help explain or justify the request.
